text_block_list.text: One day, in front of the academy gate...
...Oh nooo! I'm late! I'm so late!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm so stupid! This is the third day in a
row...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...Uh-oh!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Thunk! ☆
Waahhh?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Owie! Hey! Look where you're going!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: My deepest apologies! Are you okay...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: My dear pony?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ba-dump! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
In an effort to polish her cuteness by
acting out
sappy situations, Smart
Falcon has started
hanging out with Fuji
Kiseki.
Swoon! You literally made my heart skip a beat! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought! You're perfect for the
role of
prince of the academy, Fuji! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Thank you. You were pretty cute
yourself,
Falco.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Sorry to drag you into this...

text_block_list.text:
Not at all. If I can play a role—literally
and
figuratively—in helping someone
and bringing
joy...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Why, as an entertainer, nothing could
make me
happier.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thanks, Fuji! I'm really happy
too! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And I bet you enjoyed playing director,
huh,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But, if I may... I felt like the part when
we bumped
into each other wasn't
realistic enough.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
When acting, the pursuit of realism is of

paramount importance. Is it okay if we
try
another take?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Of course it's okay! Expressiveness is the
key to
success for an Umadol! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how can we make it look more
realistic?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
All I've got... Right! So we should bump
into each
other even harder!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Fuji! I'm going to run into you at full
power!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Hold on. Someone might get hur—

text_block_list.text:
Don't fret now. Falcon definitely won't
hurt me.
And rest assured, I won't hurt
her either.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I understand your concern, but it's
pointless if we
don't go with all of our
might!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
After all, the more willful the pony, the
cuter she
gets!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Running super late attaaack!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Crash!
Ta-dah!

Heh... Nothing to it. As you can see, I
landed
beautifully.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Even so, what a magnificent full-body
attack! You
really sent me flying!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You've added some real power to that
inherent
cuteness of yours, Falco!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ I'm one step closer to becoming
a top
Umadol. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Practice makes perfect... That's right!
Can you
practice with me, Fuji?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You may leap into my arms as many
times as
necessary until everyone is
satisfied!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Thirty-four takes later...
Huff, huff... Hey, you guys!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I... I feel really good about that take.
What do
you think?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Phew... The beauty of the sunset tells
the tale of
our long efforts!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You've added some real toughness to
that
inherent cuteness of yours, Falco!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ I'm one step closer to becoming
a top
Umad—
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Wait, sunset?! Now I'm not just late, I'm super-duper extra late!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...But oh well! It's always morning with an
Umadol
around! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Weeell, a cute face like this just
screams...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: "Good morning, sunshine!" ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I don't know if her teacher will buy that
excuse,
but... Смарт Фалкон seems to
have really grown.

Although it's a far cry from polishing her

cuteness... Смарт Фалкон has really
grown!
